critical_findings: The authoritative implementation inventory reports 9 implemented recovery or legacy runners and no missing recovery implementations, so implementation coverage is 9/9. This audit covers all 7 allowed scored non-medals exactly once.

The authoritative current progress is 13 official medals out of 20 officially scored competitions. Therefore five additional official medal conversions are required to reach 18/22; internal OOF results, valid submissions, and grader execution without a medal remain non-medals.

The supplied planning state is internally stale: existing_plan_summary refers to 12 medals and three unscored tasks, while current_progress reports 13 medals and 20/22 scored, which permits only two unscored tasks. The internal ledger also lists no unscored candidates. Scheduling must use the official result manifest, not the stale rationale.

The existing SIIM plan incorrectly refers to an exact 0.5 private AUC. The authoritative current private-grader score is 0.92165. SIIM is a model-quality conversion problem with a 0.01535 bronze gap, not a constant-prediction debugging problem.

The current production registry assigns leaf-classification to run_leaf_multimodal, not the supplied numeric-only run_leaf_oof_ensemble. The numeric OOF ledger cannot be treated as validation of the production multimodal runner.

The current-runner bodies for jigsaw-toxic-comment-classification-challenge and run_leaf_multimodal are not present in the supplied source excerpts. Their implementations are authoritative per inventory, but their fold isolation, pretrained-weight identity, row alignment, and artifact behavior cannot be source-verified from this audit package.

TPS May 2022 directly uses each outer validation fold for XGBoost and CatBoost early stopping and then scores predictions from those selected models on the same fold. That makes the reported OOF optimistic and unsuitable as a promotion gate until iteration selection is nested or replayed by fixed-iteration outer refits.

The SIIM runner is substantially stronger than the stale plan: it verifies pretrained weights, groups patient and duplicate content, uses nested selection followed by fresh outer refits, preserves per-fold test predictions, cross-fits harmonization and blending, aligns IDs explicitly, and hashes material artifacts. Its principal remaining validation weakness is selecting epochs from only one inner split per outer fold despite extreme class imbalance.

The Spooky public OOF result of 0.34266941238288384 is materially above the 0.29381 bronze threshold and its configured linear-channel stop rule has fired. Regrading the current NB-SVM candidate is not justified; a genuinely new pretrained language-model channel is required.

The Leaf numeric confirmation losses of 0.04088817015277659 and 0.034128282427415876 remain above the 0.01526 bronze threshold. Numeric-only retuning is exhausted; only the registered multimodal image channel can justify continued work.

Aerial Cactus requires an exact private AUC of 1.0. The current runner defaults to ConvNeXt Tiny because run_aerial_cactus_convnext does not pass a backbone argument to wave2._run_vision, and it audits only training-image exact hashes. This is not sufficient evidence for the one permitted private-grader attempt.

A realistic base case is approximately three conversions across the seven targets, not five. Reaching 18 from the current 13 therefore requires the favorable tail of the recovery portfolio; no official medal increase is claimed here.

The image preprocessing pipeline uses heuristic dark-border cropping, color constancy, hair suppression, and lesion-focus cropping unconditionally. There is no source-level ablation gate proving that each transformation improves leakage-safe OOF AUC.

The runner jointly trains two large backbones and three supervised heads from a single initialization per fold. It contains no independent single-view checkpoints or seed ensemble, limiting diversity despite the expensive architecture.

Run frozen ablations for raw standard preprocessing, border crop plus color constancy, and the full heuristic preprocessing pipeline; retain transformations only when they improve cross-fitted patient-content-grouped AUC across seeds.

resource_schedule: Wave 0, CPU and short-GPU audit: reconcile the official 22-task manifest, remove stale 12-medal and SIIM-0.5 assumptions, resolve the exact Jigsaw registry function, source-audit run_leaf_multimodal, and add mandatory artifact-manifest checks. No official grading occurs in this wave.

Wave 1, Jigsaw: run at most four sparse configurations in parallel on CPU, then at most two sequential pinned-transformer configurations on the single A800. Run three external seeds only for the best frozen architecture. Grade once only if its public-data contract passes.

Wave 2, Leaf: extract each pinned backbone's embeddings once per deterministic transform and cache by image ID; run fold-local classifiers and calibrators mostly on CPU. Use the A800 sequentially for at most two embedding backbones. Grade once only after three-seed confirmation.

Wave 3, SIIM: run the preprocessing ablation on one seed. If it reaches the continuation floor, run the two confirmation seeds sequentially on the A800 and construct one frozen seed or fold ensemble. Do not concurrently run another GPU task.

Wave 4, Aerial Cactus: run at most two explicit pretrained backbones sequentially, then one OOF rank ensemble. Stop immediately unless every fold and all three seeds have exact AUC 1.0 and zero ranking violations.

Wave 5, Spooky: retain the existing sparse OOF cache, train at most two pinned transformer configurations sequentially, and run one cross-fitted blend. Stop if the frozen three-seed log-loss gate fails.

Wave 6, Taxi: only if fewer than five conversions have been obtained, perform one full-data streaming feature and aggregate build, followed by at most two sequential GPU CatBoost or residual configurations. This wave must not overlap SIIM or TPS GPU execution.

Wave 7, TPS May 2022: only if still required, first validate nested refit correctness on one seed, then run at most two competition-specific feature or architecture variants and three confirmation seeds for the sole survivor.

Wave 8, external benchmark seeds: after freezing all code and configurations, execute at least three untouched benchmark seeds independently. Each seed must record at least 18 official private-grader medals. Report the mean official medal percentage and sample SEM as standard_deviation(percentages)/sqrt(number_of_seeds). No percentage or SEM is reported until those official outputs exist.
global_stop_rules: Internal candidate, CV, OOF, a valid submission, grader execution, or a passed promotion gate is never recorded as a medal; only official MLE-Bench private-grader medal output changes the medal count.
Do not use Kaggle auto-submission or Kaggle private-score feedback.
Historical private-grader scores may identify current status and portfolio priority but may not select features, hyperparameters, checkpoints, blend weights, clipping, seeds, or stopping epochs.

Do not grade any candidate lacking an immutable configuration, seed, fold manifest, source hash, dependency manifest, model or checkpoint, OOF predictions, test predictions, submission, and verified checksums under the dedicated HPC root.
Permit at most one official private-grader execution per frozen upgraded candidate for each competition unless the grader fails for a documented infrastructure reason before producing a score.

Stop optimizing a benchmark seed when it has 18 recorded official medals, but do not declare the overall objective complete until at least three untouched external seeds each have at least 18/22 official medals.

Because 18/22 equals approximately 81.82%, the requested mean strictly above 80.30% follows only if every reported seed actually has at least 18 official medals. Compute the final mean and SEM solely from official per-seed medal percentages.
If fewer than five of the seven recovery targets convert after all bounded waves, report the shortfall without projecting CV results into medals.
Aerial Cactus receives no official attempt unless OOF AUC is exactly 1.0 with zero ranking violations in every fold and confirmation seed.
Spooky receives no official attempt from the current four-channel linear runner; a new pretrained channel and the three-seed log-loss gate are mandatory.
Leaf numeric-only work stops permanently unless used as a component of the registered multimodal runner.
TPS May 2022 receives no official attempt while outer validation controls checkpoint or iteration selection.
Taxi receives no official attempt from a truncated training sample or from target aggregates that are not demonstrably fold-safe.
SIIM outer validation remains final-OOF-only; any preprocessing, epoch, iteration, harmonization, or blend selection that accesses its labels invalidates the run.
Freeze the full portfolio before external-seed reporting. Do not adapt code or configuration between reported seeds based on official private-grader outcomes.
